messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected for /v1/generate (rolling 5m). p99 = 1250ms (> 1000ms SLO). Traffic spike observed in eu-west and us-west regions. Autoscaler firing. PagerDuty incident opened: INC-2026. Triggered by rule: latency-slo-p99-5m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026 created and triggered. Assigned to rotation: @Maya Chen. Pager link: https://pd.company/INC-2026 :rotating_light:

Maya Chen: acked INC-2026 :hand: Looking now. Any immediate customer-facing errors?

Samir: seeing increased queue depth on sidecars, KV cache thrash on the hot shards. CPU on inference hosts spiking to 95%. Not seeing error rates spike (4xx/5xx stable).

Ana Rodriguez: FYI - dashboard shows a change in seq_len distribution — lots of long requests from a recent batch job. Might be a workload fanout.

Maya Chen: good call. Is the batch job identifiable? Who owns it? 

Samir: I traced requests to batch-runner-42 (internal) from analytics-team. It started at 12:02 UTC and has many long prompt prefixes (~2048 tokens).

Lee Park: paging infra-rotations for immediate throttle / kill permissions. @infra-rotations can you mute that job or apply rate limit?

infra-rotations: on it. Issuing temporary throttles to batch-runner-42, cutting it to 10rps. Also increasing autoscaler max nodes by +2 to relieve pressure.

Maya Chen: good. We'll also failover some traffic to lower-capacity model variant (gpt-small-qa) to reduce per-token latency. Can someone update routing to prefer the fallback for public API for 5m?

Samir: rolling routing rule now: `rbac route set --route /v1/generate --prefer-model gpt-small-qa --duration 300s`

ops-bot: ROUTING ACTION: Route change applied by Samir. New preference live in 3 hosts.

Maya Chen: Observability check: p95 improved to 420ms, p99 dropping but still ~820ms. That's within emergency target but still above ideal SLO. Any regressions in output quality from fallback?

Ana Rodriguez: quick eval on a sample of 200 requests shows minor degeneration in long-form answers but no customer-facing format breaks. Recommend maintain fallback for now.

Maya Chen: acknowledged. We'll keep fallback and scaled nodes. Samir please watch KV eviction rates and sidecar queue. Lee prepare for a potential PD escalation if p99 creeps back up.

Samir: KV eviction spikes dropped after throttling batch-runner-42. Sidecar queue depth down 70%. p99 holding ~760ms and trending down.

Maya Chen: great. I'm leaving the incident in monitoring state. Setting follow-up actions: 1) Tag analytics-team about the runaway batch and request a throttled re-run, 2) schedule postmortem if this recurs, 3) consider adding a rate-limit in routing to prevent single-tenant batch from hitting production hot path.

infra-rotations: Noted. We'll also add a temporary autoscaler buffer policy for the next 24h.

Maya Chen: handing off to Lee for longtail monitoring and post-incident writeup. Lee you're taking the oncall for the next 40 minutes?

Lee Park: taking it. I'll keep the PD incident open but set status to "monitoring". If p99 > 1s for two consecutive 5-min windows, escalate to SRE lead.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026 status updated: acknowledged by Maya Chen, assignee changed to Lee Park (monitoring).

Maya Chen: quick notes for the writeup — root cause: unthrottled internal batch with long seq lengths causing KV thrash and sidecar queuing; mitigation: throttled job, routing fallback, scaled nodes; impact: p99 SLO breached for ~12 minutes, no customer 5xx increase, degradation in some long-form responses.

Samir: logs snippet for context:
```
[12:05:12] sidecar-37 WARN evicting shard hot-57, cache miss rate 82%
[12:05:13] gpu-21 INFO kernel fallback triggered, qdepth=112
[12:05:15] autoscaler INFO scaling up to 14 nodes (requested)
```

Maya Chen: thanks all. Lee, I'll pair on the postmortem if needed. Closing the detailed coordination thread; keeping PD incident open for 1hr to confirm stability. :white_check_mark:

Lee Park: will monitor and close when stable. If anything pops, re-alert here.
